subject: Combining display and closed storage
hook: Display shelves fixed at one height last until you buy a taller vase.
ig:
Display shelves fixed at one height last until you buy a taller vase.

That is why the open sections on our alcove units and bookcases are usually drilled with shelf-pin rows rather than fixed shelves.

What that means day to day:
• Lift the shelf, move four pins, drop it back down
• Space for a tall plant now, room for a row of paperbacks later
• Christmas decorations, a new speaker or a framed print can go in without compromise

The holes are drilled on a 32 mm spacing on our multi-spindle boring machine, so every row lines up across the unit and the shelves sit level wherever you put them.

Fixed shelves still have their place, for example where a shelf adds strength to a tall unit. But for display, flexibility usually wins.

Which would you rather: fixed and set, or free to change? Tell us below.
fb:
A small detail that makes display shelves much more useful: rows of shelf-pin holes instead of fixed shelves.

It means you can move a shelf in a couple of minutes when a taller vase arrives, the Christmas decorations come out, or the kids' books need a lower spot. We drill the rows on our boring machine on a regular spacing, so shelves sit level wherever they go.
